title: SG-5 · Define frozen-contribution export for devion workseed handoff
summary: Documented, stable JSON export of frozen contributions per round in backend/internal/contribution
description: Context: Worldseed hands player contributions of a closed Round to devion project workseed. backend/internal/contribution has FileStore.ListByRound and ErrFrozen, and backend/internal/round writes snapshot.yaml (round, world, frozen_at, contributions with ids) on Close. No export exists. Desired behavior: a documented export with stable JSON (round id, contribution ids, authors, content, timestamps) containing only frozen contributions, independent of removed code. Why: removal of development automation must not break the handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round with a snapshot, When the export runs, Then JSON contains round id and for each frozen contribution id, author, content and created_at
Given a round with no contributions, When exported, Then JSON has an empty contributions array, not null
Given contributions on disk that are absent from the snapshot, When exported, Then they are excluded
Given the export package, When compiled, Then it imports nothing from removed packages (worker, execution) and unit tests use mocked storage

in_scope: backend/internal/contribution export code and its unit tests

technical_constraints: Go module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend; contribution must not import internal/round (round depends on contribution)
definition_of_done: Export documented, tested and go test ./internal/contribution passes
non_functional: Deterministic output order and field names
